Session name and id on the card and the orchestrator page

When you name a session in Claude Code, that name becomes the title everywhere Podium titles the session: the fleet card, the rail and the orchestrator page. No name set, nothing changes. The session id on the card matches the one on the orchestrator page (eight characters) and copies the full id when clicked.
